sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Hefydd Hen is a Welsh hero or god. His name is also written Hefaidd Hen and Heveidd Henn. The title means Hefydd the Ancient, or Old Hefydd. He was the father of Rhiannon. Rhiannon is the mythological horsewoman who appears to be a diminished goddess. Hefydd himself may have been an ancestral Welsh divinity. No recorded story explains his mythical purpose.
objective: Document Hefydd Hen, the Welsh ancestral divinity and father of Rhiannon.
